related.title: QuEra 光鑷：光束腰寬與捕捉強度尺度
related.titleEn: QuEra optical tweezers: beam waist and trapping-intensity scale
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付扣底限半對數圖、冷卻／等待整合帳與故障判別。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver floor-subtracted semilog plots, cooling/wait accounting and fault discrimination. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『QuEra 光鑷：光束腰寬與捕捉強度尺度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付強度積分、焦點敏感度與極化率資料需求。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'QuEra optical tweezers: beam waist and trapping-intensity scale', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver intensity integration, focus sensitivity and polarizability-data requirements.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學一階模型n̄(t)=n∞+(n0−n∞)exp(−t/τc)；未包含模式間不同耦合與加熱再注入。 使用合成n0=2、n∞=0.05、τc=100 μs、t=200 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.05+(2-0.05)*exp(-200/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：對n̄−0.05取log檢查斜率−1/τc；若直接對n̄取log，尾端將錯估時間常數。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：Gaussian峰值強度I0=2P/(πw²)，w為1/e²強度半徑；勢阱深度還需要極化率與失諧。 使用教學單鑷P=1 mW、w=1 μm；強度以MW/m²表示，不作雷射操作設定。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：對Gaussian截面積分應還原1 mW；若漏掉係數2，總功率將錯一倍。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Teaching first-order model n̄(t)=n∞+(n0−n∞)exp(−t/τc) excludes mode-dependent coupling and reheating. Use Synthetic n0=2, n∞=0.05, τc=100 μs and t=200 μs. Evaluate nominal expression 0.05+(2-0.05)*exp(-200/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Take log(n̄−0.05) to check slope−1/τc; logging n̄ directly misestimates the tail time constant.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Gaussian peak intensity I0=2P/(πw²) uses1/e² intensity radius w; trap depth also requires polarizability and detuning. Use Teaching single-tweezer P=1 mW and w=1 μm; express intensity in MW/m², not as a laser operating prescription. Evaluate nominal expression 2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Integrate the Gaussian profile to recover1 mW; omitting factor2 gives a factor-of-two power error.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Atom Computing 中途量測：旁觀原子擾動預算
related.titleEn: Atom Computing mid-circuit measurement: spectator-disturbance budget
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付扣底限半對數圖、冷卻／等待整合帳與故障判別。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

related.difference: 建立『Atom Computing 中途量測：旁觀原子擾動預算』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付有／無讀出配對、累積擾動曲線與中途量測的旁觀驗收。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Atom Computing mid-circuit measurement: spectator-disturbance budget', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver paired readout/no-readout controls, accumulated-disturbance curves and spectator acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學一階模型n̄(t)=n∞+(n0−n∞)exp(−t/τc)；未包含模式間不同耦合與加熱再注入。 使用合成n0=2、n∞=0.05、τc=100 μs、t=200 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.05+(2-0.05)*exp(-200/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：對n̄−0.05取log檢查斜率−1/τc；若直接對n̄取log，尾端將錯估時間常數。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：若每次讀出對旁觀量子位元造成獨立擾動p，m次後生存代理S=(1−p)^m；不代表完整量子保真度。 使用教學m=20、每次p=0.002；旁觀原子不參與當次讀出。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1-0.002)**20，另開一欄執行獨立核對：比較m=0、10、20的log(S)斜率；若非線性，檢查相關擾動或時間依賴，而非硬套獨立模型。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Teaching first-order model n̄(t)=n∞+(n0−n∞)exp(−t/τc) excludes mode-dependent coupling and reheating. Use Synthetic n0=2, n∞=0.05, τc=100 μs and t=200 μs. Evaluate nominal expression 0.05+(2-0.05)*exp(-200/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Take log(n̄−0.05) to check slope−1/τc; logging n̄ directly misestimates the tail time constant.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: If each readout independently disturbs a spectator with probability p, survival proxy S=(1−p)^m; this is not full quantum fidelity. Use Teaching m=20 and p=0.002 per readout; the spectator is not the measured atom. Evaluate nominal expression (1-0.002)**20 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compare log(S) slopes for m=0,10,20; nonlinearity calls for correlated or time-dependent models.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
